definition_used: When a journal/publisher/institution states that a paper came from a paper mill or the paper is in a list of paper mill papers. RW may also use this reason to reflect that RW has identified multiple paper mill criteria applying to this paper.
caution: Paper mill designation is a strong integrity signal but does not specify exact content flaws; it implies systemic fabrication and compromised processes.
semantic_rationale: Paper mill indicates fabricated or manipulated content (research_content_reliability), fraudulent authorship/attribution (attribution_authorship_disclosure_integrity), and subverted peer review (editorial_peer_review_governance).
